test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, 75% of the voters cast their votes. 2% of the votes cast were declared invalid. A candidate got 9261 votes which were 75% of the total valid votes. The total number of voters enrolled in that election was:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **successive percentage** method for total voters **x**.

x × (75/100) × (98/100) × (75/100) = 9261

x × (3/4) × (49/50) × (3/4) = 9261

x × (441/800) = 9261 ⇒ x = (9261 ÷ 441) × 800

x = 21 × 800 = 16800

**∴ The correct answer is 16,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Votes cast = 75%, Invalid votes = 2%, Candidate votes = 9261 (75% of valid votes).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73f4f6bdc2a2c9a92fe009f203c7dda399733fb07f61855eec6056a030dafdd1.png] 

**Step-by-step calculation:**

⇒ Total **Valid Votes** = 9261 × (100 / 75) = 12348

⇒ Percentage of **Valid Votes** out of cast votes = 100% − 2% = 98%

⇒ Total **Votes Cast** = 12348 × (100 / 98) = 12600

⇒ Total **Enrolled Voters** = 12600 × (100 / 75) = 16800

**∴ The correct answer is 16,800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Multiplication Factor

To increase or decrease a value by a%, multiply by (1 ± a/100). For example, a 2% decrease means multiplying by 0.98.

Successive Percentage Formula

When a value is changed multiple times, the final value = Initial value × (1 ± r₁/100) × (1 ± r₂/100) × ... × (1 ± rₙ/100).

Valid vs Invalid Votes

Only valid votes are considered for determining the winning margin or candidate share. Total votes = Valid votes + Invalid votes.</p
